summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly share buybacks under a pre-existing program. During August 17-21, 2026, the company repurchased 2,999,360 Class B shares on Nasdaq Stockholm at an average price of SEK 96.6970, totaling SEK 290 million. The program, up to SEK 15 billion, runs from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Goldman Sachs Europe SE executed trades. Treasury holdings rose to 100,668,676 Class B shares. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Watch for continued buyback pace and potential share cancellation impact.
